name: kamlesh-ful-bhandar-backend
description: Backend API for Kamlesh Ful Bhandar Flower & Decoration Platform

scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __createReq } from 'module'; import { fileURLToPath as __f2p } from 'url'; import { dirname as __dname } from 'path'; var require = __createReq(import.meta.url); var __filename = __f2p(import.meta.url); var __dirname = __dname(__filename);" --outfile=server-bundle.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.readdirSync('src/generated/client').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.node')||f==='schema.prisma').forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('src/generated/client/'+f, f))"
